pull.author: tuner
pull.body: Delivers candidate v1 for paper-repo. The worker keeps Codex, gpt-6.1-sol, and openai and raises native effort to medium. Exact worker configuration is candidate/v1/worker.json; provenance and rationale are recorded in candidate-record.md and candidate/v1/README.md. Target task constraints and absence of diagnostic run records are documented in the diagnostician handoff.
pull.title: Release candidate v1 worker delivery

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes: this delivery is not yet approvable. The candidate files are present, but no objective-specific judge evaluation (per-result judgements, comparison/kept-worker record, and checks), no trial-user release containing the blinded label table and run receipts, and no target-world putback continuation/round records are available. Add or link those records for this exact candidate and ensure the target configuration is checked before requesting review again.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head fefe6ab: validation now records worker check success, but the objective-specific evidence remains absent. Before approval, provide the judge evaluation and per-result judgements, trial-user release with blinded labels/index digest and run receipts, and target-world continuation/putback round records for this candidate. The validation note explicitly says these records are missing, so the delivery is not yet supported.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head a1ccd48. The added evidence-boundary file confirms that all required objective evidence is still missing: task release, blinded incumbent/candidate run receipts, judge per-result evaluations, trial-user label table/digest, and target-world continuation/putback round. Worker validation alone cannot support release approval. Reopen review after these records are published and linked.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head 34f18ea. The new evidence-boundary note only restates the prior absence and cites the earlier review; no required records have appeared. Approval still requires the objective task release, blinded incumbent/candidate run receipts, judge evaluation and kept-worker decision, trial-user label-table/digest release, and target-world continuation/putback round records. Please provide those records before re-requesting review.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head c4aeed1. No new evidence is present: trial-user and judge have published no releases, and the delivery still states that blind evaluation and putback records are absent. Do not request approval until the objective-specific task/run/judgement/label mapping and target-world round records are supplied and checkable.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head 091f081. The delivery still contains no putback round receipt/root configuration, and judge reports the trial label-table mutation leaves the blind timestamp check unsatisfied despite the preserved digest. Evaluation retains the incumbent but is not a complete approval record. Supply a completed putback world release and resolve the timestamp/integrity check before approval.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head b09d7d9. The delivery now acknowledges diagnostician commit 939be5b: only an external review repository ran, with no target-world release or comparison. Thus the required putback round did not run, and judge records remain inconsistent about the kept worker. Approval is withheld until the evaluated incumbent is correctly recorded and a verified target-world putback round/release is supplied.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head 28550d3. No completed target-world putback round or release is present; judge records mark rw_620bbabf8347 failed and unresolved. The candidate configuration and worker check do not establish the required kept-worker round. Approval remains withheld until a verified putback run/release is supplied.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head f0bd83d. No evidence changes the prior finding: the target-world putback round/release is still absent and judge records mark it failed. The candidate worker cannot be approved without a verified putback run using the kept incumbent.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes on head db82bba. No new evidence is present. The required target-world putback round and verified release remain absent, and judge still records the putback as failed. Approval is withheld until the kept worker is run in the target world and its release receipt/configuration are recorded.
